name: Full Mode Artifact DNA
summary: A seed record defining the minimum durable structure required before an ITEM concept can be promoted from expressive material into canon artifact infrastructure.
entropy_thesis: The artifact converts conceptual sprawl into stable fields that can be reviewed, versioned, routed, validated, and reused across model sessions, repositories, and implementation contexts.
implementation_paths: Validate candidate and canon JSON records against schemas/item-artifact.schema.json.
Emit ABYS task packets when an ITEM candidate lacks promotion criteria or executable surface.
Represent artifact review events as SYNTEL signed envelopes when agent coordination is required.
Promote only records that remain coherent after concise documentation, schema validation, and implementation routing.

canon_pressure.durability: Must preserve meaning after repeated model sessions, style shifts, and implementation contexts.
canon_pressure.specificity: Must contain enough structure to become a file, image, object, schema, market asset, simulation, or physical specification.
canon_pressure.anti_entropy: Must compress conceptual sprawl into stable fields that can be reviewed, versioned, and reused.
canon_pressure.execution_bridge: Must be routable into ABYS as a task packet and into SYNTEL as a protocol message when inter-agent coordination is needed.

promotion_criteria: Has a stable artifact id and name.
States what is preserved and why it matters.
Defines at least one executable or manufacturable surface.
Can be validated against a schema.
Can generate a concrete ABYS task packet.
Can survive reduction to concise documentation without losing its core identity.
rejection_criteria: Duplicate of existing canon without new structure.
Overloaded mythology with no validation path.
Cannot be routed to ITEM, ABYS, or SYNTEL without ambiguity.
provenance.next_recursive_improvement: Create a validator that checks ITEM candidates for required fields and emits an ABYS task packet when promotion criteria are incomplete.
